name: CoorCircularArc
comment: Returns n points on a circular arc centered at (x0, y0) with radius r. Argument order is x0, y0, r, startAngle, endAngle, n. Angles are in degrees from the positive x-axis, increasing counterclockwise. The points run from startAngle to endAngle and include both ends. If endAngle is below startAngle, multiples of 360 are added so the sweep stays counterclockwise. n must be at least 2; n below 2 returns #DIV/0!. Non-numeric input returns #VALUE!. Last Update at 2026-11-03.
